notes.title: Whirlight joins Indie Assemble on Steam!
notes.notes:
From May 5 to 11, Whirlight: No Time To Trip is part of Indie Assemble, a massive celebration of indie games on Steam. Over 1,000 titles from more than 600 studios are coming together for one global showcase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/1aba35ad610f7c04d66186224e90ab3260164898.png[/img]


Our demo is live and ready to play. If you enjoy quirky sci-fi, hand-drawn point-and-clicks, or time travel that definitely does not go as planned, you might feel right at home in Whirlight.

🎮 Try the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44717737/sale/IndieAssemble
No pressure, no timers, just a good excuse to play something different. We're thrilled to stand alongside developers from 63 countries and celebrate the creativity of indie games together.

Thanks to Excaliber and Steam for making it happen. Explore, discover, and support indie teams like ours.

notes.title: Whirlight - No Time To Trip Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/][b]Whirlight - No Time to Trip's Demo is now live![/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/93f18d8f5439d97203ec80f5b2dd0c009b017277.jpg[/img]

Step into the shoes of Hector, our quirky middle-aged scientist whose luck is as peculiar as his inventions. Alongside Margaret, a strong and determined artist, you'll explore the charming Verice Bay, journey through time, and meet an array of bizarre characters.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/]Whirlight - No Time to Trip[/url] is a point-and-click adventure that captures the spirit of classic games like "Day of the Tentacle" and "Sam & Max Hit the Road," with its whimsical humor, hand-drawn graphics, and engaging story. From the acclaimed developers of "[b]Willy Morgan and the Curse of Bone Town[/b]," this game promises a unique and unforgettable experience.

What's in the demo?

[list]
[*] [b]Dive into the early chapters[/b] of Hector and Margaret's adventure.
[*] Experience the vibrant, cartoony atmosphere and witty dialogue.
[*] Get a taste of the time-traveling mechanics and puzzle-solving fun.
[*] 
[/list]

🚀 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/]Play the demo now[/url] and join Hector's extraordinary journey!

🌟 We're also excited to announce our participation in the [b]Adventure Game Fan Fair on July 26-28[/b]. While we won't be attending in person, we'll be connecting with players on-site, sharing insights, and answering your burning questions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/4eff5f6a43620b03d091a3b71ad7b6f6d1b7408e.jpg[/img]

🔔 Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/][b]wishlist Whirlight: No Time to Trip[/b][/url] to stay updated on the latest news and developments. Your support helps us bring this adventure to life!

🎉 Join our community! Be part of the conversation and share your experiences with fellow adventurers on our Discord server [[url=https://discord.gg/F3HGZz2aCe]Join Here[/url]]. Your feedback is invaluable to us!

Thank you for being a part of this whimsical journey. We can't wait to hear about your adventures in Verice Bay!

If you like our demo, please consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/]supporting us with a wishlist[/url]! Happy adventuring!

[url=https://discord.gg/F3HGZz2aCe]Join our Discord server[/url] and be part of the community!

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is now available!
notes.notes:
Bone Town adventurers beware, we released Willy Morgan [b]patch 1.2 [/b] today which introduces the following new features:

[list]
[*] Added the D-pad functionality in the main menu, in the game menu and in the choice of answers for the gamepad.
[*] Introduced localization in Brazilian Portuguese and Traditional Chinese.
[/list]
[b]Note[/b]: with the v.1.2 update, partial controller support and related functions are active only if the Xbox configurator and the like is disabled. If the Xbox configurator is active you will not be able to use your gamepad correctly in game.

To disable the Xbox configurator, go to Steam> Settings> Controllers> General Settings and remove the relevant tick. With the v.1.2 update the developer recommended configuration for the Gamepad is no longer available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/629eeb831c9416429847c73520e5870a23ef7727.png[/img]

We will resolve this issue as soon as possible, thanks.

notes.title: STEAM GAME FESTIVAL IS HERE!
notes.notes:
Join us at the Steam Summer Game Festival as we're playing through Willy Morgan and answering your questions live on our Steam chat and [url=https://discord.gg/e4vpkGE]Discord[/url]!

[previewyoutube=Xxcb3BT20xQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About the game[/h2]
Willy Morgan is a pirate-themed point and click game, ispired by timeless classics like Monkey Island. Explore a modern pirate town, collect clues, solve puzzles and investigate the mysterious disappearance of Willy's father. 

[h2]About the DEMO[/h2]
This is the prologue of our story, about 30 mins of gameplay that will take you straight into Willy's world. Help him find all he needs around his house and join him in his incredible adventure!  

[h2]Additional info[/h2]
Willy Morgan is developed by [b]imaginarylab[/b], a small indie studio made of point-and-click and old adventure games aficionados, set up with the goal of telling unforgettable stories.

notes.title: Solution to our riddle
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Adventurers![/b]

Yesterday we posted a little riddle on our social pages and groups to test the skill of our dear fans of point-and-click adventures! As expected, many of you gave the correct answer but some people got tricked by a little detail: in the last row, the compass was glued with the ring in order to make a smart tool to open a piggy bank! 

So here we go, [b]63 is the solution[/b] and here's explained why:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/d4dec25c4a2931e415c8206e635c896ca237233c.jpg[/img]

[b]Bravo[/b] to those who gave the correct answer! 

The riddle was created with one of the puzzles of our game in mind, as you can see here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/ce48984388402e5b5588477deb7cf30cc381137c.gif[/img]

[b]You can find this and many other puzzles in our free DEMO! [/b](Click the link below to visit Steam page)
